subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should session catalogs permanently expose an optional `createSession` capability, with `sessions.catalog.list` scoped by `agentId` and the Gateway deciding eligibility from that agent's runtime policy?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and mechanically complete, but neither tests nor automation can decide whether this new plugin and protocol surface is the long-term product contract.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Adopt the plugin capability and agent-scoped Gateway validation as the canonical catalog-to-new-session seam.

options.title: Narrow the capability first
options.body: Require a smaller or differently owned contract before merging if catalog providers should not control model-targeted creation.

options.title: Defer catalog creation
options.body: Keep existing catalog browsing and session continuation behavior without adding the new creation surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the plugin capability and agent-scoped Gateway validation as the canonical catalog-to-new-session seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway session semantics, public protocol evolution, and plugin API ownership, matching the adjacent history and repository ownership signal.
